entries.query:
im looking for llm api provider givws at least 10$ for sign up and acces to
Proprietary models
entries.answer:
Here are the LLM API providers that hand you at least $10 (or a $10-equivalent token grant) just for signing up — and let you spend it on closed, proprietary models. A few popular names (OpenAI, Anthropic at $5 each) fall just under your bar, so I've flagged them separately.

## Providers meeting your $10+ bar

| Provider | Sign-up credit | Proprietary model access | Catch |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Mistral (La Plateforme)** | **$10/month** in free credits, recurring | Mistral Large and other closed Mistral models, plus open ones | On the Free plan your prompts can be used for training by default [1] |
| **xAI** | **$25** one-time bonus, plus $150/month if you opt into API data sharing | Grok models, all proprietary | Data sharing required for the big recurring credit [2][3] |
| **Alibaba Model Studio (DashScope)** | 1M free tokens **per model**, one-time per model | Closed Qwen flagships (Qwen-Max etc.), not just open-weight versions | Quota is per model; pricing varies by model [4] |
| **AI21 Labs** | $10, expires in 3 months | Jamba Large / Jamba Mini via their API | Credits expire; Jamba is open-weight but API-served [4][3] |
| **Upstage** | $10, expires in 3 months | Solar Pro / Solar Mini | Regional, documentation less smooth [4][5] |
| **NLP Cloud** | $15 | Mix of proprietary and open models | Phone verification required [5] |
| **Baseten** | $30 | Mostly open-weight models | Bills by compute time rather than per token [5] |

## Strong runners-up with caveats

- **Together AI** — up to $100 in sign-up credits, the biggest nominal amount anywhere. But their catalog is overwhelmingly open-source models, so it only fits if your "proprietary" requirement is flexible.[3]
- **OpenRouter** — one key to every proprietary model (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok) but no real free credit: you get $1 of credit plus 50 free requests/day on community-subsidized free models, and a one-time $10 **top-up** of your own money unlocks 1,000 requests/day and Anthropic models. It's your money, not a gift — but it's the cheapest single path to every closed model at once.[6][7]
- **OpenAI ($5) and Anthropic ($5)** — under your threshold, 3-month expiry, no card required.[8]

## My two-cents recommendation

If you want maximum free spend on genuinely closed models from one account, the xAI $25 signup bonus is the single largest no-card credit that hits a true proprietary flagship. If you want breadth across many proprietary models, the play is Mistral's recurring $10/month plus a $10 OpenRouter top-up — that combination covers Mistral's closed lineup natively and everything else (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok) through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with Mistral's month-after-month allowance doing the long-term free work. Just note the recurring tradeoff: Mistral's free plan trains on your data unless you opt out, and OpenRouter charges a 5.5% fee when you load credits by card.[1][2][7][9]
